title: Python build scripts
summary: Whether you build models with Python scripts, which helper kit those scripts use, and the functions you reach for most.

request.brief: If you build or finish models with Python scripts, include them in your project folder next to the .blend files they make (or submit them). SkillBlend reads them as text, never runs them.
must_include: The script that builds a model, next to its .blend
Your helper kit module, if your scripts import one
request.submit: Scripts are picked up automatically from the project folder.

questions.ask: Anything about how you script models that the code doesn't show?
